-- execution-service V5 — rebuild pending_order_executions with tighter column sizes

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS execution_schema.pending_order_executions CASCADE;

CREATE TABLE execution_schema.pending_order_executions (
    id          UUID          NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id    UUID          NOT NULL,
    client_id   UUID          NOT NULL,
    symbol      VARCHAR(6)    NOT NULL,
    side        VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL,
    order_type  VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL,
    quantity    INTEGER       NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    limit_price NUMERIC(19,4) NOT NULL,
    last_price  NUMERIC(19,4) NOT NULL,
    order_value NUMERIC(19,4) NOT NULL,
    status      VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT uq_pending_order_id UNIQUE (order_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pending_executions_status   ON execution_schema.pending_order_executions (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pending_executions_order_id ON execution_schema.pending_order_executions (order_id);
description: New migration DROPs and recreates a live table; every PENDING limit order resting in the table is lost on deploy (LIMIT orders stuck in SENT_TO_EXECUTION forever).
